text:
The deposition testimony is inadmissible because, although the engineer is unavailable, the company's motive in the wrongful termination case (defending against the retaliation claim) differs from its motive in the products liability case, so the former testimony exception's similar-motive requirement is not met. The company also lacked an opportunity to cross-examine the engineer on the aircraft defect liability issue now being offered.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
